prompt: How many years had passed since the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania was admitted to the Union by the time Rep. Robert D. Heaton was born?
answer: Pennsylvania was admitted to the Union on **December 12, 1787**. By Robert D. Heaton’s birth on **July 1, 1873**, **85 years had passed**—approximately **85 years and 6½ months**.
